title: SQL Server Database Schemas
last_note: All 3 Flyway SQL scripts (Discovery/Connection/Rating) and the EF Core migration (User Service) were verified end-to-end against a real throwaway SQL Server 2022 container (mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest via docker run) — created DBs matching the actual naming convention from T004's init-databases.sql (UserServiceDb/DiscoveryServiceDb/ConnectionServiceDb/RatingServiceDb, not the ticket's original snake_case names), applied all migrations with zero errors, and spot-checked tables/indexes/spatial index/FK cascade/JSON CHECK constraint with sqlcmd queries and live INSERT tests. Test container removed after verification (no residue). Followed actual repo layout src/services/<service>/... (not services/<service>/... as written generically in the ticket) since T001 already established that path. Admin Service and Chat/Report (Mongo) intentionally have no SQL schema per ticket scope.
